name: Piscivorous fish
description: Functional group pooling the estuary's top fish predators - bluefish, weakfish, summer flounder and striped bass - aggregated because all four prey mainly on forage fish (anchovies, herrings, menhaden) in the source network. Nothing in the network eats them; their losses go to fisheries and emigration. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is the summed annual mean in mgC/m2.
